periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, tilted downward from the posterior toward the anterior facial region at approximately 45 degrees.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval/elliptical shape where the length along the dominant axis is significantly greater than the transverse width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward taper toward the snout, with the patch extending further from its geometric center at the bottom than the top.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Wide, shallow U-shaped curve at the posterior edge of the dark band where it meets the white lumbar fur.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Broad band thickness, covering approximately one-third of the visible torso length from shoulder to mid-back.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Distinct spatial gap between the ears, separated by a white fur region across the cranial vault.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded hemispherical apexes without any visible flattening.
